source_text: 42.1. Idcirco animas misit, ut viarum aliae infestarent meatus, aliae circumscriberent nescios, testamenta supponerent falsa, venenatas conficerent potiones, domos ut effringerent noctibus, sollicitarent abigerent praevaricarentur et proderent, saporum fastidia ut excuterent palato, ut in coquendis altilibus pinguitudinem nossent retinere labentem, ut spirulas et botulos facerent, isicia castellamenta lucanica sumi natam cum his carnem et glacialia conditione tucceta? 2. Idcirco animas misit, ut res sancti atque augustissimi nominis symphoniacas agerent et fistulatorias hic artes, ut inflandis bucculas distenderent tibiis, cantionibus ut praeirent obscenis, numerositer et <cierent> scabillorum concrepationibus sonores, quibus animarum alia lasciviens multitudo incompositos corporum dissolveretur in motus, saltitaret cantaret, orbes saltatorios verteret et ad ultimum clunibus et coxendicibus sublevatis lumborum crispitudine fluctuaret? 3. Idcirco animas misit, ut in maribus exsoleti, in feminis fierent meretrices sambucistriae psaltriae, venalia ut prosternerent corpora, vilitatem sui populo publicarent, in lupanaribus promptae, in fornicibus obviae, nihil pati rennuentes et ad oris sacri conparatae constuprationem?
pass_a_gloss: Idcirco animas misit—for highway crime, forged wills, poison, burglary, betrayal, gourmet cookery of sausages? For holy-named souls to do obscena cantica and hip-writhing dance? For exsoleti/meretrices and venalia corpora? Reductio: not why God sent souls.
pass_b_english: 42.1. Did he therefore send souls so that some might infest the paths of roads, others circumvent the unknowing, forge false wills, mix poisoned drinks, break into houses by night, solicit, drive off, prevaricate and betray, shake pickiness of tastes from the palate, know how to keep slipping fatness in cooking fatted birds, make spiral cakes and sausages, force-meats, fort-sausages, Lucanian ones, with these born flesh and iced seasoned meats? 2. Did he therefore send souls so that things of a holy and most august name might practice symphonic and pipe-playing arts, puff out cheeks by blowing pipes, lead the way with obscene songs, and rhythmically raise noises with stampings of foot-clappers, by which another wantoning multitude of souls might be dissolved into disordered motions of bodies, dance and sing, turn dancing circles and at last, buttocks and hips lifted, undulate with writhing of the loins? 3. Did he therefore send souls so that among males there might be catamites, among women harlots, sambuca-players, harpists, so that they might prostitute bodies for sale, publish their cheapness to the people, ready in brothels, meeting in fornication-houses, refusing to suffer nothing and prepared even for the violation of the sacred mouth?

lemmas.sense: did he therefore send souls—for this?

choices.choose: Reject crime/luxury/lust as purpose of sent souls
choices.reject: God sent souls for forgery, cookery shows, brothels
choices.why: idcirco animas misit ... venalia ut prosternerent corpora—reductio

notes: Image-likeness: reductio against sending souls for crime, gourmet vanity, lewd spectacle, prostitution.
